description: Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.

c.request: For each race (`constructorStandings.raceId`), using only constructor standings entries whose season-to-date points (`constructorStandings.points`) clear the 6.0-point threshold, compute the average season-to-date points and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values (an average is missing if there are none). Then take the overall average of these per-race average wins across all races, again ignoring missing values; return nothing if that overall average is missing. List the race ID, average points, average wins, and the race's average wins minus the overall average. Show the 10 races with the largest difference first (missing differences last), without rounding. Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.
c.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points >= 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: For each race (`constructorStandings.raceId`), using only constructor standings entries with season-to-date points greater than or equal to 6.0 (entries with exactly 6.0 points included), compute the average season-to-date points and average season-to-date wins (ignoring NULLs), then compute the overall average of those per-race average wins across all races (ignoring NULLs, returning nothing if it is NULL), and list raceId, average points, average wins, and per-race average wins minus the overall average, ordered by that difference descending with NULLs last, limited to 10 rows, unrounded.
d.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points >= 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS o FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.o AS diff FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.o IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_wins - o.o) IS NULL, (p.avg_wins - o.o) DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For each race (constructorStandings.raceId), using only constructor standings entries with season-to-date points greater than or equal to 6.0 (entries with exactly 6.0 points included), compute the average season-to-date points and average season-to-date wins (ignoring missing values), then compute the overall average of these per-race average wins (ignoring missing values, returning nothing if missing), and list race ID, average points, average wins, and the race's average wins minus the overall average, showing the 10 races with the largest difference first (missing differences last), without rounding.
b.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points >= 6.0 GROUP BY raceId) SELECT raceId, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM per_race) AS diff FROM per_race ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10

a.request: For each race (`constructorStandings.raceId`), using only constructor standings entries whose season-to-date points (`constructorStandings.points`) are at least 6.0, compute the average season-to-date points and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values (an average is missing if there are none). Then take the overall average of these per-race average wins across all races, again ignoring missing values; return nothing if that overall average is missing. List the race ID, average points, average wins, and the race's average wins minus the overall average. Show the 10 races with the largest difference first (missing differences last), without rounding.
a.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points >= 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM per_race p JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
